selected_evidence.requirement: SSH CA created and host presents a CA-signed certificate
selected_evidence.summary: CA keypair generated at /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca; ed25519 host key signed into ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub; sshd_config updated with HostCertificate directive, config validated, sshd restarted.

selected_evidence.requirement: Client trusting only the CA (not pinning host key) connects without a host-key prompt/mismatch
selected_evidence.summary: known_hosts contained only an '@cert-authority * <CA pubkey>' line (no host key entries). ssh debug output shows 'Host is known and matches the ED25519-CERT host certificate' and proceeds to auth (Permission denied on publickey is expected/unrelated to host verification).
Captured boot_id 555f40d8... and uptime 64s; confirmed sshd status started and enabled in OpenRC default runlevel before restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect, and restart is proven via changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'sleep 1; reboot' returned its ack immediately; subsequent polls hit connection reset/timeout during reboot; reconnect showed new boot_id 651f5bb3... (differs from baseline) with uptime 15.88s, proving an actual restart occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of required services/data
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, sshd status is 'started', the HostCertificate config and signed cert file are intact, and the CA-trust-only SSH connection test again confirms successful certificate-based host verification, proving both the sshd service and the SSH CA setup persisted and recovered.
